preconditions: Caller has selected a valid active rival cursor. Parent scans first matching active rectangle and does not independently validate every owner/cursor invariant. Normal buyer posting assumes first-store pointer owns company0.

valuation.inspection: If signed byte+2==1 fee0, otherwise500000. Actual fee debit occurs only if byte+2==0.
valuation.premises: (trunc(tier/2)+1)*3000000 + equipment purchase value + remaining inventory procurement value
valuation.funding: First choice investigation requires cash>=fee; first choice acquisition requires cash>=price. Equality accepted.

inspection.menu: Native MSG299 調査する, MSG300 買収する, MSG301 何もしない. No rental operation established here.
inspection.unknown_flag0: Menu returns0 investigation,1 acquisition,2 no-op. Direct acquisition available without prior investigation if guard/funds allow.
inspection.investigate: Debit500000 via first-store capital-post helper, set target byte+2=1, redraw UI. It is not credited to seller.
inspection.known_flag1: Native4D6EC calls detailed report4D8C8, waits acknowledgement and returns default2. Do not use arbitrary synthetic child choices after inspection.
inspection.scope: This records this child path only. Other writers/lifetime of byte+2 beyond the covered path are not fully mapped; no claim that all later acquisition UI is permanently blocked.

acquisition.main_guard: First choice acquisition checks store flags LOW8 bits==1, shows enemy-main-store refusal. Normal source serials1..99 make this the founding-store guard.
acquisition.money: Call1CBC4(first-store,+price) then1CBC4(target,-price), before changing target owner flags. Normal cash0 decreases and cash1 increases; capital ledgers record opposite signed amounts.
acquisition.serial: Increment player u16 serial0x800cd9e0 and write target u16+4. It is not replaced by number of currently active stores.
acquisition.staff: Call1B320(mode1): keep all staff references, write each linked staff ownership to new store flags; reset specified store ledgers/counters/history. No person skill/wage reset in that child.
acquisition.town: Call1BAAC: activate with own building tile kind0/1 selected by low8 serial; place at unchanged rectangle origin and rebuild permit masks. Then refresh cache and invoke milestone3EAD4.
acquisition.rng: Price/guard/parent funding contain no random negotiation. Town placement may consume RNG while assigning source customer mixes; do not label whole acquisition RNG-free.

sale.selection: Use own-store list from1BD78; block selected list index0 (main shop), and block any selected store with signed C77!=0; original message says 開店中は売却できません.
sale.quote: land+premises(mode0), without acquisition multiplier. Confirm1 then post negative land and premises separately to selected store owner via1CBC4.
sale.staff: Call1B320(mode0) to release staff ownership and refs.
sale.closure: Call1BB80 to clear town corners with empty kind12, initialize record with source defaults, rebuild masks; reset byte+1, refresh cache and call milestone3EAD4.
sale.counterparty: No corresponding rival cash debit appears in this recovered sale branch; do not implement it as transfer to rival ownership.

scope: Price/binding/reset source-data extraction. No actual new acquisitions/sales or APK changes in this work.
